reviews.title: Great Value & Quality
reviews.comment: Excellent airflow and the cable management space is a lifesaver. The 3 included ARGB fans look premium and the Type-C port is a nice modern touch for a build at this price.
reviews.author: Pretty good over all good quality chain is good length for 5,11 height packaging is nice good product nothing wrong with it

reviews.title: Great budget case for under $60. Would definitely recommend
reviews.comment: I just got this case and it looks great! The fan hub that comes pre installed makes the building process faster and easier. The fans that come with it are pretty quiet and look good. Cable management is easy. It doesn’t take up too much room on my desk, and it doesn’t seem flimsy or cheap (for the price). Airflow doesn’t seem to be a problem so overall just a nice case. The best I could find for the price. The only complaint I have so far is that the side panel isn’t the easiest to take off. I have to use a little bit more force than I’d like to but it still functions.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Yet another amazing case from Okinos!
reviews.comment: Why did you pick this product vs others?: I’ve had experience with another Okinos case in the past, and you can’t beat the quality at this price point. It also has room for an AIO on the top. This case checks all the boxes for my application and at an amazing price. Airflow: I used some Thermalright TL-C12RB-S V2 fans in place of all the Okinos fans because I wanted them to be PWM fans. I believe they may cool a bit better than the ones that come with the case as well. I also made all 3 fans reverse blade so it’s also pulling from the back of case as well. I wanted a bit of positive pressure in the case to keep fresh air in, but I was also worried the bottom fans would have quite a bit of resistance pulling through the small air gap. I may change this later, but it seems to keep pretty good air flow and temps as it is right now. It seems as though it gets great airflow with the current set up now even with its small size and fish tank style. Cable management: There is a ton of space in the back of the case for cable management, so (in my opinion) it was a breeze getting everything organized. Lots of room with a regular full modular 850w ATX power supply and I even have an HDD installed back there. Noise level: Noise level is very low but I don’t have an air cooled CPU. I’m using an AIO, so it helps with keeping temps cooler and fan speeds lower. Side note: The case is no where near as loud in person as it sounds in the video. I think my phone just tries to enhance low level sounds automatically. lol Functionality: There is a ton of functionality in this case. I even had room to mount a huge sensor panel where the ssd spot is. I love that it has plenty of front panel ports as well as a USB-C port. I do wish it had the ports on the bottom toward the side of the case like the Aqua 9 has but it’s understandable when the case is this small. Summary: Overall, I highly recommend this case for those looking to make a high end small form factor Micro ATX build. It worked great for me and I’m very satisfied with this case at the price point.

reviews.title: Awesome case. Great price
reviews.comment: Awesome case. Great for a matx motherboard. I added a 240mm radiator on top and it fit without a hitch. The only thing that stumped me was the argb control panel on the back. I wasnt sure what I needed but i eventually got every thing set straight. The metal is high quality and so is the glass. The fans that come with it are quiet and haven't had a problem with them. It has one usb c connector and 2 usb a connector. I also love the magnetic filters on the top and bottom of the case. Its easy to clean. So far I haven't found a single bad thing on this case. Also it brings enough screws in the case to add all your components.

reviews.title: Dual Chamber, Compact, Impressive Designed Case.
reviews.comment: The Mirage 4 is one of my new favorite cases. When I got it in person the size surprised me. The weight and packaging surprised me it was very well packed and came with nice foam for protection during shipping. The GPU support is surprisingly large and the fish-tank design is great. The Dual Chamber design makes this system easy to use and manage cables and have a full size power supply as well with no compromises. The quality of the case and lightweight design of the case surprised me.
